name: career-os-extension
description: Chrome MV3 extension for Career OS job capture, policy gating, and sync.

scripts.zip: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const archiver = require('child_process'); if (process.platform === 'win32') { archiver.execSync('tar -a -c -f dist/career-os-extension.zip -C dist manifest.json background.js popup.html popup.js options.html options.js content.js'); }"
